summary.text: Helen Kerwin is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 58 who has represented the district since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A small business owner, she previously served as mayor of Glen Rose and as a Somervell County Commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Helen Kerwin's career experience includes working as a small business owner and entrepreneur, according to Ballotpedia.

She served as mayor of Glen Rose and as a Somervell County Commissioner, and has served on the North Texas Council of Governments Executive Board, as a 4-H Superintendent, and as an FFA Horse Judging Coach.
She received the Texas A&M Outstanding Service Award.
Kerwin took office on January 14, 2025, succeeding DeWayne Burns.
She defeated Mary Wells in the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Chris Oldham in the general election.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she listed securing the border, election integrity and educational freedom as her campaign's key messages.
